rows.evidence: How and Why We Share Your Information: At Temu, we care deeply about privacy. While Temu shares your personal information for the purposes of targeted advertising, which may be considered a “sale” under applicable U.S. state privacy laws (as described further in the Privacy Policy Addendum for U.S. Residents), Temu does not “sell” personal information in the traditional sense. We may share your personal information with the following parties for the purposes outlined below: Affiliates: As a global company, our Service is supported by entities within our corporate group.

Interest-based advertising: We, our service providers, and our third-party advertising partners may collect and use your personal information for interest-based advertising purposes. For example, we may use your interactions with the Service (e.g., your browsing, searching and purchasing history on the Service), and information included in your account profile (e.g., your country if recorded) to show you interest-based advertising on our platform, which displays a merchandise partner’s listing or product more prominently.

We generally retain personal information as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which we collected it, as well as for the purposes of satisfying any applicable U.S. legal, accounting, or reporting requirements, to establish, exercise or defend legal claims, or for fraud prevention purposes.

We receive and collect your personal information from our marketing and advertising partners, such as business partners with whom we collaborate on marketing events and promotion of the Service. Specifically, we receive from these partners information including, for example, the specific advertisements you clicked on, attribution information via cookies and similar technologies to help us determine the origin of traffic to our Service, device data if you clicked on certain advertisements, responses to marketing emails, advertisements and offers, and audience information from marketing partners where they have the authority to share that information with us.

Your Rights and Choices: We provide you with the ability to exercise certain rights and choices regarding our collection, use and sharing of your personal information. In accordance with applicable laws, your rights and choices may include: Rights to access, delete and correct your personal information: You may have the right to access, delete or correct your personal information, in addition to other rights under applicable U.S. privacy laws. Please see the Privacy Policy Addendum for U.S. Residents for more information. You could delete your account in the “settings” section of the app.

We do not use information which on its own personally identifies you, such as your name or email address, to show you interest-based advertising. In providing interest-based advertising, we follow the Self-Regulatory Principles for Online Behavioral Advertising as set forth by the Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA), which is an advocacy organization for responsible digital marketing and consumer privacy.
